blocks.text: One call unites every believer, regardless of their specific gift or ministry: the ministry of reconciliation. Every member of the body of Christ carries a primary duty to bring sinners to the knowledge of Christ and lead them to accept Him as Lord and Saviour. "And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given us the ministry of reconciliation" - {{2co 5:18|2 Corinthians 5:18}}. This is precisely why Jesus commanded, "go ye into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature" - {{mk 16:15|Mark 16:15}}.

Every other ministry activity must go alongside, not replace, the ministry of reconciliation - {{1co 9:16|1 Corinthians 9:16}}. Souls must be reconciled to Christ before they can be called into ministry.

A worker is chosen and equipped for a specific purpose: to bear fruit - {{jo 15:16|John 15:16}}. That fruit comes in two categories: the fruit of the Spirit - {{gl 5:22,gl 5:23|Galatians 5:22-23}}, and the fruit of soul-winning - {{prv 11:30|Proverbs 11:30}}, {{ez 33:7,ez 33:8,ez 33:9|Ezekiel 33:7-9}}. To bear fruit that lasts, a worker must first abide in Christ - {{jo 15:5,jo 15:16|John 15:5, 16}}.

There's an urgent need for aggressive evangelism and mission outreach - the harvest is plentiful, but the labourers are few - {{mt 9:37,mt 9:38|Matthew 9:37-38}}. This isn't optional for a Christian worker, because:

items: It's God's desire that the light of the gospel cover the whole world - {{gn 1:2,gn 1:3|Genesis 1:2-3}}, {{is 60:19|Isaiah 60:19}}, {{nm 14:21|Numbers 14:21}}.
God has chosen us as the means by which His light and glory will shine to the whole world - {{mt 5:14,mt 5:15,mt 5:16|Matthew 5:14-16}}.
We are to go into all the world to preach His word and make disciples.
We are to support those who go and preach, by sending clothes, books, materials, food, and money to missionaries.
We are to pray fervently for missionaries, and for all who don't yet know Christ.
